prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original transparent production game sprite of the redesigned kiosk's FRONT/SOUTH FACADE, matching the approved concept.
Reference image is the approved two-panel concept. Follow its exterior lower front facade: OPEN entry at LEFT, single sales window at RIGHT, cream plaster and sage metal trim. This asset will sit directly below an existing complete rectangular roof. It is NOT a whole building or a concept board.

Draw one continuous shallow upright FRONT FACADE band in nearly overhead 2.5D orthographic game style. All main edges axis-aligned and camera matches the reference. Very wide rectangle, world width:height approximately 3.6:1. Full straight cream upper header, cream plaster side pier at far left, sage lower wall base, clear open rectangular doorway in left quarter, one stocked sales window and honey-brown counter across right two thirds, far-right cream/green pier. No side entrance.
Precise horizontal layout: first solid cream pier covers about x0–12% of sprite width; doorway's clear opening covers x12–31%; right-hand shop wall and sales window cover x31–100%. Door opening begins below a thin header about 12% down and stays genuinely transparent all the way through the BOTTOM edge. Narrow sage doorframe strips flush to jambs, shaded inner jamb faces, no leaf, no threshold or step blocking the opening. A small wall lamp and vertical plate exact text "入口" mounted on left solid pier. No freestanding extra posts.
Sales window: muted product rows and daily goods on shelves at back and at both sides, ONE wood sales counter at bottom, one dark register placed toward left of counter, a small order pad and a pencil cup. Leave clear space around center of counter for the game to render an existing blue-clad vendor separately. Absolutely NO person, no cashier painted into this sprite, no orange player, no duplicate counter or second room. Honey-brown wood with modest wear and hand-painted details.
No main roof, corrugated awning or giant shop name sign: the engine supplies those separately above this facade. No floor, scenery, trash bin, ground, walls behind the doorway, road tiles, opaque interior backfill, cast-shadow rectangle, backdrop, labels, watermark. ONLY front wall/frame, entry lamp/sign, stocked right window and one counter.
Genuine transparent alpha outside all silhouettes and throughout the OPEN doorway, letting the actual game floor show through. No diagonal perspective or protruding side door. Neutral soft overhead daylight, subdued sage/cream/wood palette, crisp painted edges, same detailed utilitarian factory-campus art as the approved concept. Fill canvas with the full facade and keep small transparent margins, all parts visible.
